expectedBehavior: Explicit playback starts with only the required short click-free ramp and reaches a stable reference tone promptly, without rhythmic startup clicks.
notes: Reported during physical-device Watch testing. Applies the same startup concern observed on iPhone.
observedBehavior: On iPhone and Watch, after explicit Play, a rhythmic clicking sound can occur for several seconds before the output settles into the expected sine tone; the Play control can remain visually stale until startup completes.
reproductionSteps: Install the latest build, select a pitch, and tap Play on the built-in speaker; listen from playback request through stable sustain.

workItem.title: Reference tone clicks rhythmically during startup before settling
